purpose: Pinned normalized official Toast Standard GET/2xx response-field schema with original official-source SHA-256 and repository candidate crosswalk; NOT proof of café scopes, retention, shared readers or Supervisor answerability
source_notes: Official original Swagger 2.0 YAML files fetched read-only from Toast-owned doc.toasttab.com in trusted GitHub Actions; each raw response SHA-256, spec version, GET operation and nested 2xx response-property path was extracted to this normalized inspectable JSON. Original YAML bytes are not committed; source URLs and SHA pin reproducibility.

Schema presence and get-operation enumeration do NOT prove per-café authorized scopes, returned optional fields, current-object persistence, differential history, live SQL lineage, Supervisor queryability or screen parity.
October 28 redacted diagnostic observations remain in the existing normalized matrix: never treat them as live source records or as the official schema.

Exact stock and packaging Swagger-path versus gateway request-prefix discrepancies were classified against Toast's own operation-page curl examples, without any café API call. See official_registry_comparison.route_prefix_classification; source GET shape is pinned, runtime availability is not proven.
Current approval remains POS0a audit-only; no runtime, credentials, dispatch, new authority or database writes.

excluded_or_separately_entitled.reason: Standard API access only permits Menus V2
Analytics API access is separately entitled; no Standard bulk assumption
Partner access is not in the Standard scope table
Only classify verifiable Standard GET operations; some are no-GET or outbound

official_registry_comparison.interpretation: Two exact Swagger GET paths omit the /stock or /packaging gateway family prefix, whereas the official Toast operation-page executable curl examples explicitly include /stock/v1/inventory and /packaging/v1/published/packagingConfig. The two candidates are classified as documented route-prefix presentation differences, not missing Standard GET operations. Preserve both original Swagger paths and real external request paths; no café grant, HTTP success or current writer-reader parity is inferred. Menus V3 is excluded from Standard.

official_field_resolution.source_row_key: family | exact official GET operation.path | exact 2xx response status | exact source response field[0]; type/format/null marker are the immutable response field[1..3] from official_snapshot
official_field_resolution.enumeration: Every official 2xx row inherits its family's H-code storage/reader contract here; exact path prefixes below override narrower source scope/privacy/gap. Longest matching field_prefix wins. An exception applies to itself and its nested descendants (dot or []), never an unrelated field with the same leading letters.
official_field_resolution.evidence_boundary: This is a conservative source-to-CURRENT-CODE+PROPOSED-READER architecture crosswalk, NOT café permission/observed field/verified retention/integrated availability proof. October diagnostic outcomes never upgrade any status.
official_field_resolution.privacy_default: FIELD_LEVEL_REVIEW_REQUIRED: allowed noncredential business facts retained only with grants, café RLS and security checks; identity/contact/staff/payroll data only under allowed scope and role; card PAN/CVV/track/auth secrets/payment credentials never retained; legacy redactor drops more than owner target. Default DOES NOT certify safe retention.

BUSINESS_FIELD_REVIEW; retention/SQL reader not independently verified
